name: Sagan Memorial Station
about: Sagan Memorial Station (1996-068A, NASA/JPL), launched 1996 Dec  4. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Mars. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.
